sourceNotes.rawContent:
Minimal, modern, and effortlessly stylish — our Triple Layer Herringbone & Bead Anklet combines three chain styles in one: a flat herringbone snake chain, a delicate satellite bead chain, and a thin box chain, all layered together for a rich stacked look without the fuss of wearing multiple pieces separately.
- 💛 Gold-plated with anti-tarnish coating — lasting everyday shine
- ✨ 3-in-1 layered design — herringbone + bead satellite + box chain
- 🔗 Flat herringbone chain — smooth, sleek & modern
- 📿 Satellite bead chain — adds subtle texture and dimension
- 📏 Adjustable extender chain for a perfect fit
- 🔒 Secure lobster clasp
- 🎁 Perfect for beach, casual wear & gifting
Pairs beautifully with: Bare feet, sandals, flowy dresses, kurtis, and western co-ords.
Avoid contact with water, perfume, and chemicals to maintain shine.
